negative_controls.description: Dropping every pairing that targets P-dom must set complete=False and list P-dom in coverage_gaps; the intact schedule is silent (gaps=[]).
P-proc is non-substantive. Leaving it unexamined, or dropping its pairings, must not create a coverage gap.
Author A examining P-dom does not count; P-dom remains a gap.
propose_followup past max_depth returns DEPTH_BOUND; max_depth=1 schedules are complete and flat.
A scheduler that only examines the weakest position reports P-dom as a gap, negative correlation, and favours_weak_leaves_dominant_unchallenged=true.
